title: Platform News
text:
This is a Quarto website.
To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.

title: Platformization
text: Platformization describes the growing trend of news being produced and distributed through – and increasingly by – digital platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. This process fundamentally alters news production, prioritizing algorithmic engagement over traditional journalistic norms. Consequently, news are assumed to be more visually-driven, emotionalized, and personalized, often delivered by non-traditional actors.
